scenes.narration: An MCP server speaks JSON-RPC. The only question is the pipe: stdio for a local subprocess, or HTTP plus Server-Sent Events for a remote service.
Here is a complete server. FastMCP turns a typed Python function into a tool, and mcp.run defaults to the stdio transport.
The client spawns the server, sends initialize, lists tools, and calls add. Three round trips, all over stdin and stdout.
Same protocol, different transport. Pick stdio for local tools, SSE when the server lives on the network.
